---
name: release-communication-skills
description: Generates formatted release notes for Infrabel Design System v3
trigger: 'On CHANGELOG.md update'
---

# output_config:

output_folder: "release-note"
output_filename: "release_note.md"
output_description: |
Create the release note as a markdown file in the 'release-note' folder at the project root.
Filename format: release_note.md (can also use versioned naming like release_note_v{{version}}.md if needed)
Always ensure the folder exists before creating the file.

# parsing_rules:

version: "Extract the latest H2 or H3 version number from CHANGELOG.md (e.g., 18.0.19)"
features: "Map all items under 'Features' section to 🚀 New Features & Components"
styles: "Map all items under 'Styles' section to 🎨 Style Updates"
fixes: "Map all items under 'Bug Fixes', 'CI/CD', 'Chore', 'Documentation', 'Tests' sections to 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Infrastructure"
package_versions: |
IMPORTANT: Use the CHANGELOG version number for package versions, NOT the current package.json versions.
Only include @infrabel packages in the output (do NOT include primeng or other dependencies):

1. '@infrabel/infrabel-components-angular': Use the CHANGELOG release version (e.g., if changelog says [18.0.19], use 18.0.19)
2. '@infrabel/infrabel-theme-primeng': Use version that matches the release (typically one minor version behind components, e.g., 17.0.29 for release 18.0.19)
   Format as a markdown table with only @infrabel packages.

# output_template: |

# Design System v3 Release v{{version}} is now available!

{{intro_text}}

### 🚀 New Features & Components

{{features}}

### 🎨 Style Updates

{{styles}}

### 🛠️ Bug Fixes & Infrastructure

{{fixes}}

**Link:** [Changelog]({{changelog_url}})
**Update:** https://dev.azure.com/INFRABEL/a1831-ds/_artifacts/feed/a1831-dsv3-feed or https://artifactory.msnet.railb.be/ui/repos/tree/General/infrabel-design-system-npm-local/
**Packages:**
{{package_versions}}

# automation:

The release note is automatically generated by `scripts/automate-release.sh` at **Step 9**.

- Implementation: `scripts/generate-release-note.js`
- Output: `release-note/release_note.md` (transient, gitignored — not committed)
- Package versions are read from actual `package.json` files at release time
- Intro text is auto-composed from changelog entry counts and the top feature highlight
- Can also be run standalone: `node scripts/generate-release-note.js --version <ver> [--changelog-url <url>]`
